name: wifi_fade
title: Walking away from the access point
description: Signal fades, retries climb, the link rate collapses. The classic cause of a call breaking up, and the one users most often misdiagnose.

card.title: The far end is slow to answer
card.summary: Your router and the path out to the internet both look normal, but the services we test are taking 87 ms to send their first byte, about 69 ms more than the network itself explains.
remediation: Check whether other sites are fine; if they are, the problem is at the far end and not with your connection.
Check the service's own status page.
Wait a few minutes; this often clears on its own.

card.title: This device looks like the problem
card.summary: The signals that changed are on this machine rather than on the network around it: CPU 20%, 1.1% of connections retransmitted.
remediation: Close whatever is using the most CPU or bandwidth on this device.
Restart this device's network adapter.
Check for an update to this device's network adapter driver.

remediation: Move closer to the access point, or remove what is between you and it.
Switch to the 5 GHz network if your access point offers one.
Plug in an ethernet cable for anything important in the next few minutes.
